ownership: Exact registration, relay and subscription; monotonic private scope identities; stale connection generations cannot capture. Scope drop and registration finalization remove only their owned originals.
correlation: The exact pinned upstream decoder and SHA256 of its serialization correlate a parsed notification to the original queued object. This key is not authenticity, profile admission or replacement wire evidence. FIFO retains distinct original spellings independently.
fetch: Existing monotonic work/byte/frame budgets, ordered finalization and partial results remain. Missing originals or queue loss produce incomplete evidence, never reserialized fallback.
live: Uses the same aggregate original queue with independent scope disposal, no inherited cumulative fetch budget and a wakeable loss signal. Queue loss or missing original returns a source error without advancing an event checkpoint. Cancelled live scopes do not invalidate another scope's physical connection.
admission: Original objects pass through SignedEvent.raw_json to the owning protected reader. Only that reader establishes complete signature, recipient, seal, rumor and record bindings. Original source data alone supplies no business authority.
limits: This contract governs original network evidence, not a second transport or durable journal.
